title: Stage 3 Mixture-of-Experts Adversarial Assessment: Keyboard Window Ergonomics, ARIA Live Regions, Non-Blocking Toasts & CI Simulator Parity

findings.title: AUD-07: Blocking window.alert() in Tampermonkey menu commands and TTS fallback halted thread execution and could leak/stall across frames
findings.resolution: Replaced all 3 GM_registerMenuCommand alert() dialogs with Shadow DOM Trusted-Types-safe showGlobalToast() + announceLive(), replaced App.tsx toggleTts alert() fallback with scoped showTtsToast(), and added static test #30 guarding zero blocking alert() calls in youtube-feed-summariser.user.js.

findings.title: Suite 3 D_options_test / D_captions_pure request matcher race against concurrent background alt-title :generateContent requests
findings.resolution: Updated test_pipeline_and_api.js waiters and assertions to filter :generateContent traffic by target video payload so concurrent background alt-title traffic cannot hijack assertions.

roadmapReview.notes: Stage 4 decomposition of src/App.tsx and shared core helper parity checks are well-scoped next after closing all Stage 3 blocking dialog and sanitization risks.

findings.title: AUD-06: Resize handles registered mousedown listeners without cleanup entries in _interactionCleanup, and window resize events left floating windows un-clamped
findings.resolution: Tracked every resize-handle mousedown/keydown and window resize listener inside _interactionCleanup so minimize()/close() leaves zero retained handlers (verified in Check 44 via orphaned handle dispatch).

findings.title: Capture-phase TTS global shortcuts intercepted Arrow/Shift+Arrow keystrokes when keyboard-resizing separators or moving the drag grip
findings.resolution: Guarded setupKeyboardListeners() in youtube-feed-summariser.user.js and handleKeyDown() in src/App.tsx against active .yt-resize-handle / .yt-win-drag-grip elements; verified zero spurious TTS seeks during keyboard move/resize.

roadmapReview.notes: Adding Suite 5 Playwright Simulator CI checks inside run_all_tests.js establishes automated regression coverage across all 5 suites (445 total E2E assertions + 30 unit tests).

roleReviews.roleTitle: UX, Visual Layout & Spec Compliance Critic

findings.title: AUD-09: Desktop-to-mobile (<400px) viewport resize left existing Simulator & userscript windows overflowing right edge and .yt-window-box content-box sizing overflowed 375px by 2px
findings.resolution: Added box-sizing: border-box on .yt-window-box, adaptive marginX=8 bounds clamping below 400px, live viewport resize re-clamping in both youtube-feed-summariser.user.js and src/App.tsx, and max-w-full min-w-0 on compact selects; verified 375x812 live Chromium capture at winLeft=8, winRight=367, scrollWidth=375.

findings.title: FEAT-05: Missing north/top-corner resize handles, keyboard arrow move/resize, and ARIA live announcements
findings.resolution: Implemented all 8 directional resize handles (role=separator, tabindex=0), focusable .yt-win-drag-grip, Arrow (16px) and Shift+Arrow (48px) adjustments via shared applyKeyboardWindowAdjustment(), and polite ARIA live regions in both Shadow DOM and React Simulator.

roadmapReview.notes: Stage 4 (App.tsx modularization, shared parity check, timestamp jump-sync, per-channel alt-title rules, summary personas) is ready to execute.
